ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
094
Behind the image
67 / Peplum Tweed
REFERENCE 5849.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 049
Art direction: Soft powder blue against white and grey, sculpted tailoring, clean full-length framing
on a pale studio wall.
Photorealistic full-length vertical fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with
light brown hair in a low, loose bun, a calm direct gaze and hands gently clasped in front of her.
She wears a fitted powder-blue brushed-tweed jacket with padded shoulders, a peplum hem and a
white satin bow collar edged in lace with a small crystal detail, matching blue tweed mini skirt,
large silver hoop earrings, grey ribbed over-the-knee socks and black velvet mules. Pale grey
seamless studio backdrop, soft even diffused light, muted powder blue and white palette, crisp
tweed texture, polished contemporary tailoring campaign, no text or logos.
68 / Crystal Choker
REFERENCE 5850.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 049
Art direction: Runway close-up with a jewel-toned palette, gold against deep navy, softly blurred
models in the background.
Photorealistic vertical runway close-up portrait of an original adult woman with dark brown hair
swept back in a low, center-parted style, light blue-gray eyes, defined brows and soft peach lips.
She wears a layered crystal and gold statement choker with a dark stone pendant, long crystal
drop earrings, and a sheer gown with heavy gold leaf embroidery over a metallic silver-gold
bodice. Softly blurred runway models in the background, crisp even runway lighting, shallow
depth of field, gold and deep navy palette, couture editorial detail, no text or logos.
